postmortem: The room overcorrected toward mutual guilt, concrete receipts, and anti-perfect-husband mechanics. It failed creator taste: the idea feels like generic online-shopping sitcom content, not @a.storyof.two romance-story IP. The obstacle is thin, the legalistic statements/alibi wording is try-hard, and the visual world is not cinematic or emotionally memorable.

why_it_wins: It is more visually instant and more taggable than the other fresh candidates. It avoids the stale perfect-husband engine because both partners are guilty and both protect the tiny nonsense together.

Grocery Cart Witness: relatable, but risks bill-shock scolding.
Family Group Chat Translator: promising, but needs an authentic phrase/source moment.
